cases.result: An argument-free Redirect module now renders the frozen missing-destination error instead of generic unknown-module output. Valid imported redirects keep the existing bounded destination resolver and 301/noredirect contract. Unsupported destination shapes remain literal and cannot widen into a redirect.

The existing typed render, Ajax action, permission gate, bounded format validation, atomic autosave, and browser helper cover the evidence-backed NewPage contract. This lane adds no duplicate action path.
Missing and empty ids render the frozen error. A present id renders the escaped initial read-only shell in preview and saved output without restoring page-authored active content.

The frozen form includes a request-bound numeric identity and opaque definition token, but no local authority currently issues or validates that token. The existing post-render form reconstruction is not acceptance evidence and no inert replacement form or fabricated token was added. Recipient resolution, CSRF, rate limiting, header injection defense, delivery, successPage navigation, and repeated-submit behavior remain actionable.

No frozen action surface establishes task creation, editing, checkbox state, ordering, link changes, real-time persistence, replay, or saved-page edit permission. No speculative shared-id data model or mutation endpoint was added.
MailForm and SimpleToDo loading, success, error, focus, keyboard, history, reload, and repeated-submission intervals remain unproved on an exact served candidate.

ThemePreviewer, ManageSite, Clone, Dashboard, PetitionAdmin, and closer-free argument-free SiteGrid produce their frozen anonymous error or unavailable states through the public page preview seam. FTML does not type this exact closer-free SiteGrid source, so its established bounded raw-source path remains documented debt and was not broadened. Anonymous output remains query-free and no module performs a mutation.

FTML pin 62ebba4efda1f10e82363c23c925061fbe939e49 preserves body-bearing unknown modules as typed name, ordered arguments, and body. Deepwell resolves only a root SiteGrid node whose name is exact, arguments are empty, and trimmed body is empty, through both public PagePreview and saved-page seams. Literal-owned source stays text. Argumented, populated, case-variant, and foreign runtime nodes retain FTML's generic fail-closed output; no raw body scanner or final-HTML recognition was added.

ManageSite and PetitionAdmin now re-resolve the request actor against the current site's existing site:edit permission. Authenticated non-administrators receive the exact actor B/C live denial DOM in PagePreview and saved page_view. Anonymous ManageSite retains its login-capable DOM. Administrators are never mapped to the denial: without a faithful legacy panel owner, both administrator modules remain on FTML's generic fail-closed output.

The administrator captures establish a large legacy ManageSite panel, ManageSiteGeneral settings form, and an active PetitionAdmin shell, but Wikijump has no faithful public adapter from those legacy DOM contracts to the existing Framerail administration owner. They remain generic fail-closed rather than duplicating policy or exposing controls without a complete local read model.

The read-only capture does not establish campaign storage, identifier collisions, CSRF, rate limits, export privacy, create/update/delete atomicity, replay, or browser transitions. Administrator controls and mutations remain unavailable rather than rendering authored JavaScript without an authorized local action contract.

Dashboard returned Not allowed for administrator and non-administrator actors, while Clone returned Site cannot be found for all three captures. Their positive authenticated states remain unobserved and this denial slice does not infer them.

No local source and destination selection contract establishes eligibility, collision behavior, CSRF, rate limits, atomic copy, rollback, replay, or navigation. Remote Wikidot cloning remains forbidden and no inert clone action was added.

The argument-free empty error and typed empty-body ownership are implemented. Local or remote site identity resolution, random selection, limit semantics, thumbnail resources, descriptions, private-site non-disclosure, and browser hovertips are not observed. A SiteGrid with any argument or non-whitespace body remains on FTML's generic fail-closed path rather than inferring populated behavior from documentation alone.
The noUi theme_url request contract, scheme and host policy, CSP, size and timeout bounds, applied theme interval, and stale-state cleanup are not frozen. No external stylesheet fetch was added.
Authenticated administration navigation, modal actions, intermediate paints, focus, history, error recovery, and stale-state cleanup require exact candidate browser evidence.
